title: AFNI Bootcamp
description:
Welcome to the AFNI software package video documentation-- the AFNI Academy.  These videos represent an online expansion of "Bootcamp" courses that we, the AFNI developers, teach around the globe.  Topics include everything from a brief overview of FMRI through quality control, study design, preprocessing, statistical analysis, and more.  In all cases, we strongly emphasize **looking at your data** to be able to understand it, and we demonstrate how to do so effectively and interactively with the AFNI GUI.

In case you didn't know, AFNI is a software package for Analysis of Functional NeuroImages - primarily Functional MRI (FMRI), as well as Diffusion Tensor Images (DTI). See:
   bit.ly/AFNIstuff
for details, starting with information about how to install AFNI.

Please direct questions to the AFNI Message Board-- we're always happy to hear new ideas too.  Much of AFNI functionality has been developed over time because of good ideas from users like you!
